item.title: China embeds ‘loyal wingman’ drone simulations in fighter pilot training
item.description: China’s military is increasingly integrating artificial intelligence – including AI-driven “loyal wingman” drones – into its routine training for frontline fighter pilots, official media reports have confirmed. People’s Liberation Army newspaper PLA Daily showed the growing use of manned-unmanned teaming (MUM-T) simulation training systems that feature support from accompanying drones, as well as AI-enhanced simulated battle conditions. item.title: Hong Kong government holds firm on proposed 3-year certification renewal for teachers
item.description: Authorities have rejected a call from Hong Kong educators for a proposed practising certificate to be renewed every five years rather than every three, saying the longer time frame would not meet the expectations of society and parents in a fast-paced world. Secretary for Education Christine Choi Yuk-lin on Wednesday moved the second reading of the Education (Amendment) Bill 2026 in the Legislative Council. item.title: Could potential US tariffs put the US-China trade truce at risk?
item.description: The United States could be paving the way for fresh tariffs on imports from 16 economies, including China and the European Union, as it prepares to release the findings of a months-long investigation into excess industrial capacity. Higher tariffs could be announced as early as this week, the Wall Street Journal reported on Tuesday, citing people familiar with the plans. We examine the potential duties, the investigation behind them and what they could mean for Washington’s fragile trade truce...

item.title: US says Latin America is too dangerous – unless you are seeking asylum
item.description: In its travel advisories, the US State Department warns Americans not to visit Honduras’ Gracias a Dios region, alerting them to violent crime, armed robbery, murder and active terrorist groups. But for Hondurans, the message is less stark. “Overall, Gracias a Dios is a low-crime, functioning department,” says a State Department background report. The report, and similar documents about Guatemala, Mexico and El Salvador, were prepared for use in immigration courts, where asylum denial rates have...

item.title: China calls on Netherlands to help safeguard industrial and supply chains
item.description: China has called on the Netherlands to help safeguard supply chain stability and stabilise Beijing’s relations with the European Union, during Dutch Foreign Minister Tom Berendsen’s visit to Beijing.
